nodes.label: Ownership and readiness contracts
nodes.description: Asset map objects are not caller-owned, tasks may self-delete, and Loaded assets need not have ready GPU resources. Serialization readers and writers must change together.

nodes.label: Header documentation
nodes.description: Document classes, structs, members, and functions with purpose and relevant parameter, return, ownership, lifetime, unit, and constraint contracts.
nodes.rationale: Comments explain useful purpose and contracts rather than merely restating declaration names.

nodes.label: Explicit native/managed project items
nodes.description: Inspect ownership and callers, follow namespace/export style, enumerate source in project files, update umbrella headers where appropriate, and build consumers for API/ABI changes.

nodes.label: Profiling and diagnostics change workflow
nodes.description: Keep OS queries in platform and Diligent/ImGui capture in engine. Preserve bounded asynchronous polling and validity without waits/flushes or fake zeros. Register project files and run diagnostics, CPU/accounting, GPU tests with explicit backend evidence. Never silently replace allocators or change caller ownership.

nodes.label: Native platform changes
nodes.description: Keep OS services under Nuclear.Platform/Source/Windows and neutral NPAPI headers. Preserve C# key values and event/window contracts; adapt UI input in the engine and run platform tests.

nodes.label: Core source map
nodes.description: Maps public headers, engine/client/module lifecycle, scene/ECS, transforms, paths, IDs, and diagnostics to their owning declarations and implementations.

nodes.label: Platform dependency boundary
nodes.description: Native services belong in Nuclear.Platform; its public headers must avoid native OS headers and engine dependencies. Only its Windows backend exists.

nodes.label: Focused changes
nodes.description: Preserve unrelated changes and dirty submodules; avoid incidental toolset changes, dependency updates, API renames, or unrelated reformatting.

nodes.label: CPU GPU and memory profiling guide navigation
nodes.description: Profiling.md is the guide for CPU/GPU queries, memory diagnostics, frame capture, explicit allocation accounting, and profiler UI.
nodes.norm_label: cpu gpu and memory profiling guide navigation

nodes.label: Source takes precedence over guides
nodes.description: Read the relevant guides, inspect git status/diffs, find ownership, then verify current implementation and callers. Source takes precedence; preserve unrelated changes and dirty submodules.

nodes.label: Validation evidence
nodes.description: Record commands and actual outcomes; do not present an untested command or transient machine state as established repository behavior.

nodes.label: Source precedence
nodes.description: The guides are navigation aids based on inspected source; claims must be checked against implementation and resolved limitations removed.

nodes.label: Repository boundaries
nodes.description: The map separates engine and platform DLLs, scripting libraries, audio plugins, editor, managed bridge, ScriptCore, samples, assets, dependencies, and local outputs.

nodes.label: Guide inspection basis 2026-09-21
nodes.description: The original guide basis is source inspected on 2026-09-21 at commit 5c56558e plus the working tree. The guides remain navigation aids, with subsequent changes documented, rather than proof that every subsystem builds or works.

nodes.label: Human readable code
nodes.description: Use descriptive names, simple control flow, and spacing in both headers and source; avoid tightly packed walls of code and compressed statements.

nodes.label: Entity registry handle
nodes.description: ECS::Entity wraps a registry pointer and entity identifier; EnTT validity/lifetime still governs components and retained pointers.

nodes.label: Proposed staged migration
nodes.description: Establish manager/services/events first, then split runtime, graphics, scripting, editor and dynamic plugins.

nodes.label: Proposed cycle-breaking shared abstractions
nodes.description: Extract RenderTypes/ECS abstractions rather than circular runtime dependencies.

nodes.label: Scripting.Lua future scaffold
nodes.description: Implements shared interface but always declines initialization; no Lua runtime, bindings or registration.

nodes.label: NativeCalls Cdecl ABI
nodes.description: InitBindings uploads native callbacks into Nuclear.NativeCalls unmanaged Cdecl function-pointer fields. NativeString handles strings and booleans cross as 32-bit integers.

nodes.label: Managed API coordinated change
nodes.description: Keep NativeCalls fields, C++ declarations/bindings, exact registration names, managed types, component registration, interop widths/lifetimes, project entries, and copied runtime assemblies consistent.

nodes.label: Lua backend remains scaffold
nodes.description: Lua remains a buildable interface scaffold with no runtime or startup registration; engine startup registers C#.

nodes.label: Nuclear.Managed included source fork
nodes.description: Managed C# assembly and native host library, .NET10; namespaces renamed from upstream.

nodes.label: Scripting source map
nodes.description: Maps generic scripting interfaces, C# backend hosting/registration/bindings, included bridge discovery, script object lifecycle, and managed API examples.

nodes.label: ScriptingModule backend registry
nodes.description: ScriptingModule owns a registry and selects one backend; Engine::Start registers C# before scripting initialization. Lua remains an unregistered scaffold.

nodes.label: Managed component registration
nodes.description: ScriptingRegistry maps Nuclear.Managed type IDs to implemented EntityInfo and Light component add/has operations; unknown IDs fail without inserting empty callbacks.

nodes.label: Managed entity script callbacks
nodes.description: ScriptingSystem binds entities before OnStart and invokes OnUpdate. Backend object handles are destroyed before context unload, and class lifetime tokens reject stale construction.

nodes.label: Nuclear.Managed .NET bridge
nodes.description: The included Coral-derived Nuclear.Managed fork hosts .NET 10, selecting a stable hostfxr and loading ScriptCore plus client assemblies in one collectible context; CoreCLR remains process-wide.

nodes.label: Bridge deployment limits
nodes.description: Windows x64 validated path in README; custom DOTNET_ROOT and self-contained deployment not implemented.

nodes.description: Nuclear.Platform is a first-party foundation built by the solution, replacing SDL. It isolates native windows, input, events, clipboard, and library loading, currently for Windows x64 only.

nodes.label: Future platforms and roadmap
nodes.description: Only Windows x64 is currently supported; other desktop/mobile backends and remaining engine integrations require implementation and validation. Roadmap items are intentions.

nodes.label: Assets and rendering
nodes.description: The README describes asynchronous asset import/export, UUID identity, Assimp and FreeImage import, lights, PBR, shadows, image-based lighting, and animation-related work.

nodes.label: Windows build
nodes.description: The concrete solution uses Visual Studio 2026 and MSVC v145. Dependencies are prepared separately using the repository scripts and their own build tools.

nodes.label: Nuclear Engine work in progress
nodes.description: Work-in-progress C++20 3D engine with EnTT-based ECS, native rendering, C# scripting, physics, audio, and editor functionality.

nodes.label: Managed wrappers incomplete
nodes.description: Only EntityInfo and Light currently have managed wrappers and registered add/has component operations.

nodes.label: Build Assets Library
nodes.rationale: Selector action imports content and needs other model inputs; placing source files does not generate imported assets needed by Samples 2-5.

nodes.label: Fallback module
nodes.rationale: Creates black, grey, white and flat-normal textures synchronously in memory; old DefaultTextures/*.png files are no longer startup prerequisites. Synchronous decode failure returns black fallback.

nodes.label: Historical startup evidence
nodes.rationale: 2026-09-23 startup reached rendering and loaded .NET 10.0.12; older logs include XAudio master-voice failure. Sample3 OnStart and missing imported PBR assets were observed, without validation of every sample or graceful shutdown.

nodes.label: LearnOpenGL sample content mapping
nodes.rationale: resources objects nanosuit/cyborg/vampire, PBR texture folders, skybox faces, HDR newport_loft, and container2 textures map to Assets/Common Models/Textures/Skybox paths. @CommonAssets@ resolves to Assets/Common from Samples.

nodes.label: x64 .NET10 runtime discovery
nodes.rationale: Managed projects target .NET 10 and solution Any CPU. Windows host selects highest stable numeric .NET 10 hostfxr in the system Program Files installation; custom DOTNET_ROOT is unsupported.

nodes.label: Nuclear.Managed
nodes.rationale: Included source fork of Coral with upstream revision/MIT attribution, comprising a net10.0 managed DLL and native static library; no Coral submodule or Premake step.

nodes.label: Local sample prerequisites
nodes.rationale: LearnOpenGL subset lacks Bob, CrytekSponza, shaderball, crate_normal.png, arial.ttf and str3.mp3. Most source content is ignored by Git; local presence does not make a clean checkout complete.

nodes.label: Sample runtime prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Verify managed DLLs/manifests, native DLLs beside executable, installed runtime, and exact sample content before launch.

nodes.label: SamplesScripts
nodes.rationale: Managed sample project copies assembly and dependency manifest into Samples; a focused check is dotnet build SamplesScripts/SamplesScripts.csproj -c Debug /m:1 /nr:false.

nodes.label: Sample validation matrix
nodes.rationale: Sample1 mesh/animation; Sample2 shaders/PBR/render paths; Sample3 physics/scripts; Sample4 cameras/resize; Sample5 async assets. Module/audio changes need plugin build and backend playback; core lifecycle needs selector/sample entry-exit and shutdown logs.

nodes.label: Samples working directory
nodes.rationale: Intended launch directory inferred from relative asset paths and managed post-build copies; Engine::Start searches this directory for ScriptCore and Nuclear.Managed files.

nodes.label: Nuclear.ScriptCore
nodes.rationale: Post-build copies its runtime files plus Nuclear.Managed assembly/runtimeconfig/dependency manifests to Samples.

nodes.label: NuclearEngine.log
nodes.rationale: Written in working directory and truncated on logger construction; preserve failure logs before reruns. Selector exit 0xC000013A means console cancellation, not the earlier texture failure.

nodes.label: Samples/Main.cpp
nodes.rationale: Uses ../Assets and current-directory SamplesScripts.dll; active startup defaults to D3D11 and does not call SelectRenderer.

nodes.label: Headless platform CPU and memory diagnostics
nodes.description: CPU topology/counters, process/system memory, opaque GPU identity and exact-adapter process budgets work without a window and hide Windows/DXGI types. Renderer queries, allocation accounting, history, and ImGui remain in the engine.
nodes.norm_label: headless platform cpu and memory diagnostics

nodes.label: ImGui platform adapter
nodes.description: Engine ImGuiPlatform handles portable events, UTF-8 clipboard, cursor shapes, display size, and timing while retaining the Diligent renderer; only main-window docking is supported.

nodes.label: Compatibility and file helpers
nodes.description: Engine Window/Input forwarding headers remain, with foundation includes/import library and DLL deployment required. GetSDLWindowPtr is removed and graphics takes Window*. FileSystem remains engine-owned because of paths/blobs/shader dependencies.
nodes.rationale: FileSystem stays in the engine because its contracts depend on engine paths, blobs, logging, and shader processing.

nodes.label: Native library services
nodes.description: Foundation owns executable discovery and native library load/symbol/unload. Windows loads absolute library paths with library-directory/default search; engine retains plugin policy/ABI/object ownership.

nodes.label: Nuclear.Platform foundation
nodes.description: Independent C++20 DLL replacing SDL, with no engine, Diligent, ImGui, or logging dependencies. Public headers use standard types and opaque native handles.
nodes.rationale: The foundation stays below engine and renderer dependencies so native backend work does not depend on higher-level systems.

nodes.label: Window and event thread lifetime
nodes.description: Initialize, create, pump, destroy, and shut down on the event thread. Window objects are noncopyable; handles/event pointers are borrowed. Close events retain native handles for renderer teardown.
nodes.rationale: Close events retain the native handle so clients and GPU resources can shut down before native window destruction.

nodes.label: Raw mouse and focus
nodes.description: Locked mode uses foreground raw relative motion, cursor hiding, and client confinement. Focus loss clears held keys/buttons and releases confinement; focus regain restores the requested mode.

nodes.label: Engine smoke fixture
nodes.description: Nuclear.Platform.EngineSmoke.vcxproj is separate from the default solution build. Build with Debug x64 MSBuild options and launch from Samples/. It disables audio, physics, scripting, and worker threads while exercising engine, Diligent swap chain, ImGui, callbacks, resize, and shutdown.

nodes.label: Migration evidence and limits
nodes.description: On 2026-11-06 the full Debug solution passed and the Debug engine fixture rendered 12 frames, resized to 960x540, handled mouse/scroll, and completed client/module/window shutdown with exit 0. Binary inspection found Nuclear.Platform rather than SDL imports. Default Samples was blocked by XAudio master-voice creation. Full Release engine, physical input feel, clipboard interaction, and secondary-window UI were not validated.

nodes.label: Windows backend and future ports
nodes.description: Only Windows x64 exists under Source/Windows. Future ports must implement neutral contracts, preserve key/mouse values, add native build selection, and provide a Diligent handle adapter.
nodes.source_location: Platform foundation; Extending to another platform

nodes.label: Physical keys and Unicode text
nodes.description: Physical key identifiers preserve existing USB HID values shared with C#. Text is separate Unicode scalar input, including combined UTF-16 surrogate pairs.

nodes.label: Headless nonblocking networking services
nodes.description: Platform networking provides independent UDP/TCP sockets, IPv4/IPv6 endpoints, synchronous resolution, readiness, and explicit results. Sockets automatically retain runtime lifetime without window/event-thread startup; replication/session protocols belong above the foundation.

nodes.label: Portable event translation
nodes.description: PollEvent pumps native Windows messages and returns neutral events before each frame. Engine forwards close/resize/movement/scroll to clients and portable input to ImGui.

nodes.label: Scene snapshot coverage
nodes.description: EnTT/zpp::bits persistence currently enumerates only EntityInfoComponent, LightComponent, and MeshComponent; new component persistence is not automatic.

nodes.label: Scene and EnTT registry
nodes.description: Scene owns the EnTT registry, system manager, main-camera pointer, and current scene-asset pointer.

nodes.label: Scene component persistence incomplete
nodes.description: Scene snapshots currently save/load entity info, light, and mesh components only; persistence of other components is not automatic.

nodes.label: EntityInfoComponent transform/name
nodes.description: Scene::CreateEntity adds EntityInfoComponent carrying the transform and name; dependent components should use that creation path.

nodes.label: SystemManager unordered updates
nodes.description: SystemManager stores shared systems in an unordered_map. Update_All does not guarantee insertion-order simulation, and clients drive their scene systems explicitly.

nodes.label: System update order unspecified
nodes.description: SystemManager uses unordered-map iteration; adding systems in a sequence does not guarantee that update order.

nodes.label: Component lifecycle and persistence changes
nodes.description: Trace EntityInfo/transform and EnTT lifecycle assumptions, register systems in the scene, define update/resize/teardown explicitly, and update persistence/readers/writers when needed.
nodes.source_location: Add or change an ECS component/system

nodes.label: EditorClient assembly prerequisite
nodes.description: Editor startup requests EditorClient.dll, but the solution has no project producing it; native editor presence does not prove complete runtime setup.

nodes.label: Editor consumes runtime scene
nodes.description: The native ImGui editor uses the same engine/ECS scene with inspectors and panels, not a separate authoritative scene model.

nodes.label: PhysX SDK and ECS simulation
nodes.description: PhysXModule owns SDK objects; PhysXSystem owns a simulation scene and connects collider/rigid-body components to actors.

nodes.label: Platform source map
nodes.description: Points to Nuclear.Platform headers and Windows backend plus engine ImGuiPlatform adapter; engine FileSystem remains responsible for paths/blobs/shader processing.

nodes.label: No general first-party suite documented
nodes.description: Focused Windows platform smoke and headless networking loopback projects exist, but no general engine test suite or tracked CI workflow is documented. Evidence stays scoped to actual checks.

nodes.label: Validation and graph refresh
nodes.description: Run meaningful affected builds and samples, distinguish evidence from expectations, update guides, and refresh structural code plus affected document semantics before handoff.

nodes.label: Documentation validation
nodes.rationale: Documentation-only changes need relative link/source-path checks and git diff --check, without engine rebuild.

nodes.label: Headless networking build and validation
nodes.rationale: Separate headless project passed Debug/Release IPv4/IPv6 UDP/TCP and full Debug solution on 2026-11-06; Windows SDK ws2_32 links without third-party runtime. Replication/remote networks/full Release remain unverified.

nodes.label: Platform migration validation
nodes.rationale: 2026-11-06 full Debug solution and standalone platform Debug/Release smoke passed. Engine smoke rendered 12 frames, resized 960x540, received mouse/scroll and exited 0 with audio/physics/scripting/threading disabled; default Samples then failed XAudio master voice creation.

nodes.label: Platform smoke project
nodes.rationale: The focused Windows platform test project is built separately and exercises translation/lifecycle checks; migration validation on 2026-11-06 records standalone smoke success in both Debug and Release. Platform changes also need sample input/UI interaction checks.

nodes.label: Profiling SDK dependencies and measured validation
nodes.norm_label: profiling sdk dependencies and measured validation
nodes.rationale: 2026-11-06 diagnostics passed Debug/Release; CPU accounting and 70-frame D3D11 GPU/UI tests passed Debug with full Debug solution. Optional Diligent GPU queries and SDK dxgi/psapi dependencies do not establish other backends or full Release.

nodes.label: Validation by affected sample
nodes.rationale: No general engine test suite/tracked CI; build affected projects and exercise relevant sample, and do not substitute vendor test counts for engine evidence.

nodes.description: Apache License version2.0 text.

nodes.label: Assimp and Poly2Tri notices
nodes.description: BSD-style attribution; model test assets may have separate creator terms.

nodes.label: EnTT MIT attribution
nodes.description: Michele Caini copyright and MIT terms.

nodes.label: PhysX4.1 NVIDIA notice
nodes.description: NVIDIA redistribution notice and disclaimer.

nodes.label: SDL2 notice
nodes.description: Origin, altered-source and notice retention restrictions.

nodes.label: Nuclear Project license terms
nodes.description: Repository license has permissive grant, notice retention, product-credit condition and warranty disclaimer.

nodes.label: Bundled MIT dependency notices
nodes.description: zpp::bits, spdlog, fmt reference, msdf-atlas-gen and glm notices.

nodes.label: Allocation accounting bounds and rejection
nodes.description: At most 65536 live identities, 256 categories, and 128 characters per category. Null/zero-sized, duplicate, overflowing, and over-capacity registrations are rejected; rejection counts disclose incomplete coverage. Unknown/double frees return false.

nodes.label: ProfilingModule dependency and shutdown lifecycle
nodes.description: AutoInitProfilingModule defaults true. Register after Graphics when enabled and release GPU queries before graphics teardown; CPU-only initialization is supported.
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Unambiguous renderer match or explicit LUID selection
nodes.description: Automatic adapter selection is withheld if multiple GPUs share renderer PCI IDs. Select an exact LUID in the UI or SetGpuMemoryAdapter; selected memory and rendering adapters may intentionally differ, and UI names the selected adapter.
nodes.norm_label: unambiguous renderer match or explicit luid selection
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Independent platform diagnostics
nodes.description: CPU, process/system memory, and adapter queries live in Nuclear.Platform without window initialization or dependencies on Nuclear.Engine, Diligent, or ImGui. Windows/DXGI types remain private.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Profiling limits and opt-in measurement
nodes.description: Capture defaults off; GPU results are asynchronous/optional and runtime-tested on D3D11 only. Allocation identities are explicit without allocation stacks/complete heap coverage; no hardware temperature/clock counters. System CPU load unavailable across multiple Windows processor groups.

nodes.label: CPU and GPU frame capture boundaries
nodes.description: Capture starts after events before queued work/module updates and includes client Update/Render scopes. GPU queries end before Present; CPU frame time ends after Present and includes presentation blocking. Direct BeginFrame/EndFrame share boundaries; earlier work is excluded.
nodes.norm_label: cpu and gpu frame capture boundaries
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Normal submission required for GPU completion
nodes.description: D3D11 timestamp results require that frame FinishFrame. Engine Present supplies normal lifecycle; custom loops must honor Diligent context completion rather than forcing profiler waits.
nodes.norm_label: normal submission required for gpu completion
nodes.rationale: A profiler must observe normal frame completion asynchronously rather than force GPU synchronization and distort the timing being measured.

nodes.label: Headless Debug CPU and accounting validation
nodes.description: Debug CPU tests verified topology/memory queries, interval validity, concurrent explicit accounting, CPU scopes/aggregation, cross-frame rejection, and history/capture limits without a window.
nodes.norm_label: headless debug cpu and accounting validation

nodes.label: Disable and reset preserve live allocation identities
nodes.description: Disabling blocks new tracking while permitting existing frees. ResetCounters keeps live allocations while resetting peaks and cumulative counters. Tracked bytes remain separate from OS working set/private commit and do not attribute GPU allocations.
nodes.norm_label: disable and reset preserve live allocation identities

nodes.label: Independent durations and native query overlap limits
nodes.description: Duration uses independent timestamp pairs and allows overlapping regions. Same-type native pipeline-statistics/occlusion queries cannot overlap on a context. Disable module capture for custom overlapping pipeline queries because capture occupies one. OpenGL only supplies clipping invocations for pipeline statistics.
nodes.norm_label: independent durations and native query overlap limits

nodes.label: Opt-in frame capture
nodes.description: EnableProfiling defaults false. Enable through startup description, ProfilingModule::SetEnabled, or the profiler Capture checkbox. Registration alone does not record frames.
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Exact session-local GPU adapter identity
nodes.description: EnumerateGpus returns names, PCI vendor/device IDs, opaque session-local adapter LUIDs, software flags, and capacities.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Asynchronous GPU frame correlation and validity
nodes.description: GPU results update their original frame IDs asynchronously. Pending, unsupported, disjoint, invalid, or dropped results never become valid zero durations. Drop/error counters and support/validity flags are exposed.
nodes.norm_label: asynchronous gpu frame correlation and validity
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Bounded owned frame snapshots
nodes.description: GetSnapshot returns a mutex-consistent owned copy; history retains at most 240 completed frames and 2048 CPU scope records per frame.
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Monotonic nanosecond clock
nodes.description: GetTimestampNanoseconds measures elapsed monotonic nanoseconds, not CPU cycles or calendar time.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Duration, Timestamp, Occlusion, PipelineStatistics
nodes.description: GpuQuery provides paired-timestamp Duration, single Timestamp, sample-count Occlusion, and backend-dependent PipelineStatistics. Duration results are milliseconds; timestamps include raw ticks and frequency.

nodes.label: Optional Diligent backend query features
nodes.description: Graphics requests timestamp, pipeline-statistics, and occlusion support optionally on D3D11/D3D12/OpenGL/Vulkan. Unsupported queries do not fail startup; runtime profiling validation currently covers D3D11 only.

nodes.label: Fixed bounded asynchronous GPU query pools
nodes.description: Initialize with a live retained Diligent device and 1..256 submissions, default 8. A full pool returns CapacityExceeded; polling later frames does not flush, spin, wait for idle, grow pending pools, or overwrite in-flight results.
nodes.norm_label: fixed bounded asynchronous gpu query pools

nodes.label: Profiling validation and hardware coverage limits
nodes.description: No full Release engine build, manual editor menu interaction, hardware-counter/temperature/clock profiling, or D3D12/OpenGL/Vulkan runtime query validation is established. Explicit tracking does not provide allocation stacks or complete engine heap coverage.
nodes.norm_label: profiling validation and hardware coverage limits

nodes.label: Periodic counters and normalized CPU load
nodes.description: OS process/system and selected-GPU memory counters are sampled at most every 500 ms during capture. CPU utilization requires two samples; process load is normalized to all logical processors on a 0..100 percent scale.
nodes.norm_label: periodic counters and normalized cpu load
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: Profiling and diagnostics architecture
nodes.description: OS queries remain in Nuclear.Platform; engine ProfilingModule coordinates opt-in capture, bounded asynchronous queries, CPU scopes, explicit allocation accounting, and UI with lifecycle after Graphics and release before teardown.

nodes.label: 70-frame Debug D3D11 GPU and UI validation
nodes.description: On 2026-11-06 Debug GPU integration rendered 70 frames on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti/D3D11, drew profiler UI, retrieved seven valid results per Duration/Timestamp/Occlusion/PipelineStatistics type, checked bounded pending capacity/frame correlation, and shut down cleanly. Audio/scripting/physics/worker initialization was disabled.
nodes.norm_label: 70-frame debug d3d11 gpu and ui validation

nodes.label: Diagnostics Debug and Release validation
nodes.description: On 2026-11-06 platform diagnostics passed in Debug and Release on Windows x64.

nodes.label: Inclusive per-thread CPU scopes
nodes.description: PROFILE_CPU uses mutex-protected CpuScope recording, copies up to 128 label characters into fixed entry storage, and supports worker threads. Inclusive nested totals overlap; worker wall-time totals may exceed frame wall time.

nodes.label: Legacy GPU helper result and shutdown contract
nodes.description: Profiler_GPU/PROFILE_GPU use bounded queries. End(double&) fixes by-value output and writes completed seconds while preserving pending output. End() returns ambiguous zero while pending, so prefer explicit GpuQueryStatus. Static helpers require Shutdown before renderer teardown.
nodes.norm_label: legacy gpu helper result and shutdown contract

nodes.label: Cumulative CPU counter units and intervals
nodes.description: QueryCpuCounters returns process/system cumulative CPU times in 100-nanosecond units and a monotonic sample timestamp in nanoseconds; consumers compute interval differences.
nodes.norm_label: cumulative cpu counter units and intervals
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Per-process exact-LUID GPU memory budgets
nodes.description: QueryGpuMemory uses an exact adapter LUID for node-zero local/non-local memory budget and current-process usage. These are not global GPU memory usage, static VRAM capacity, or GPU utilization. A driver may not expose budgets.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Physical and process memory semantics
nodes.description: QueryMemoryInfo reports total/available physical bytes, resident working set/peak, private committed bytes, and page-fault count. Working set includes shared pages; private commit is not virtual address reservation.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Diagnostic result and output preservation
nodes.description: QueryResult distinguishes Success, Unavailable, and Error with native diagnostic codes. Output references and lists remain unchanged on failure. Windows SDK dxgi.lib and psapi.lib suffice.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: CPU scope frame lifetime and drops
nodes.description: Scopes must finish or join before their original frame ends. Cross-frame and over-capacity records are dropped rather than assigned to another frame. Capture/history storage still allocates memory.
nodes.norm_label: cpu scope frame lifetime and drops
nodes.rationale: Keep each inclusive CPU region attached to its actual originating frame; late records must not contaminate another frame.

nodes.label: System CPU multi-group limitation
nodes.description: System CPU counters are unavailable on machines with multiple processor groups because Windows GetSystemTimes only covers one group; process counters remain usable.
nodes.rationale: Do not present GetSystemTimes for a single processor group as a whole-machine CPU load measurement.
nodes.source_location: Platform CPU, GPU, and memory queries

nodes.label: Full Debug solution build validated
nodes.description: The full Debug solution build passed for this profiling implementation.

nodes.label: Explicit allocation identity accounting
nodes.description: Thread-safe MemoryProfiler starts enabled and accounts only caller-registered pointers, sizes, and categories. TrackFree records before actual free/reuse; ownership remains with the allocator. No global new/delete interception, vendor coverage, call stacks, or real deallocation.

nodes.label: Separate diagnostics, CPU, and GPU test projects
nodes.description: Three projects outside the default solution build are Nuclear.Platform.DiagnosticsTests, Nuclear.Profiling.CpuTests, and Nuclear.Profiling.GpuTests. Use normalized Visual Studio environment; GPU executable runs from Samples.
nodes.norm_label: separate diagnostics, cpu, and gpu test projects

nodes.label: Pending and invalid GPU output contracts
nodes.description: TryGetResult Pending preserves output; invalid timing frequency or order returns Error with output unchanged. Query status and snapshot flags distinguish unsupported or pending measurements from genuine zero.
nodes.norm_label: pending and invalid gpu output contracts

nodes.label: GPU query render-thread and device lifetime
nodes.description: Use the initialized device immediate context on its owning render thread. Pair Begin(context,frameId)/End for Duration, Occlusion, PipelineStatistics; use WriteTimestamp for Timestamp. Shut down queries before renderer teardown.
nodes.norm_label: gpu query render-thread and device lifetime

nodes.label: AudioSourceComponent
nodes.rationale: SetAudioClip assigns/binds borrowed clips and does not create a backend source. Controls require nonzero source/buffer and loaded/created clip; pitch calls backend pitch. SetIsLooping caches a flag; backend looping comes from clip at source creation.

nodes.label: AudioSystem
nodes.rationale: Creates backend source for scene AudioSourceComponent; Playground uses it instead of assigning an uncreated standalone source.

nodes.label: PhysX pending-module-reference shutdown error
nodes.rationale: Playground harness shutdown logged this error despite zero exit status; automated lifecycle checks do not establish error-free PhysX shutdown.

nodes.label: Playground
nodes.rationale: Creates listener/source on controller via AudioSystem after successful import and nonzero clip buffer; missing audio skips playback. Shutdown pauses playback, restores normal mouse input, clears scene then flushes imported assets.

nodes.label: Playground uncreated audio source crash
nodes.rationale: Temporary Debug harness reproduced vector bounds assertion when standalone component passed source ID zero to XAudio2 before source creation.

nodes.label: Playground Debug lifecycle validation
nodes.rationale: 2026-11-06 full Debug build passed. Harness loaded actual Playground twice for 240 D3D11 frames per run with local str3.mp3 and deliberately missing audio path; both exited 0. Checked source/buffer creation, controls, guards and clearing; missing arial.ttf was nonfatal.

nodes.label: Playground validation limits
nodes.rationale: Automated lifecycle/control calls do not verify manual selector interaction, audible playback, Release, or other rendering/audio backends.

nodes.label: Graph relationships are evidence, not runtime validation
nodes.description: Extracted document relationships preserve attributed claims; proposal concepts are identified as proposed.
nodes.norm_label: graph relationships are evidence, not runtime validation

nodes.label: Repository knowledge graph guide
nodes.description: Graphify navigation, query/path/explain examples using explicit node IDs to avoid ambiguous names, update commands, scan scope and interpretation.

nodes.label: Graphify first-party scan scope
nodes.description: Supported engine/editor/plugin/managed/sample source and guides, with vendor/generated exclusions; vcxproj, NuclearShader and HLSL are not parsed.

nodes.label: Legacy monotonic CPU timer in milliseconds
nodes.description: Profiler_CPU::End returns elapsed milliseconds without reset, while Reset starts another measurement. Both consistently use steady_clock.
nodes.norm_label: legacy monotonic cpu timer in milliseconds

nodes.label: Editor and sample profiler access
nodes.description: The editor Window > Performance & Memory Profiler and sample selector checkbox open the tool. DrawProfilerWindow(bool*) also supports an active custom ImGui frame; it displays timing, per-thread scopes, pipeline counters, memory, and allocation categories.
nodes.source_location: Enabling capture and opening the profiler

nodes.label: AssetLibrary owns asset maps
nodes.description: AssetLibrary stores typed assets in UUID-keyed maps; pointers and references into those maps follow library ownership and lifetime.

nodes.label: AssetManager import/load/export facade
nodes.description: AssetManager exposes import/load/export; Importer handles new source content and Loader handles previously exported content/metadata.

nodes.label: Audio backend plugin ABI
nodes.description: Audio plugin ABI checks size, version, name, and factories. Shutdown destroys the backend before unloading its DLL; JSON manifests are metadata and are not scanned.

nodes.label: Audio backend DLL selection
nodes.description: AudioModule selects XAudio2 or OpenAL by backend DLL name. AudioSystem connects sources/listeners; the descriptor can override the executable plugin directory.

nodes.label: Client application callbacks
nodes.description: Client supplies empty default callbacks. LoadClient calls Initialize and Load before the blocking loop; clients choose how to update scene systems.

nodes.label: Engine lifecycle
nodes.description: Engine initializes asset paths and the platform window before registered module phases, then loads a client and drives event polling, tasks, module updates, UI, rendering, and presentation.

nodes.label: EngineModule lifecycle contract
nodes.description: EngineModule is the shared lifecycle base for built-in/application modules. CallbackModule currently adapts only AssetManager.

nodes.label: Asset readiness states
nodes.description: IAsset exposes Unknown, Deserialized, Queued, Loaded, and Created states. A returned non-null asset may still have asynchronous work pending and need not have ready GPU resources.

nodes.label: Left-handed zero-to-one convention
nodes.description: NE_Common.h selects left-handed coordinates and zero-to-one clip depth; math, C++ buffers, and shader code must change together when adjusting conventions.

nodes.label: Platform foundation
nodes.description: Nuclear.Platform is an independent DLL below the engine. Its Windows backend owns native services; the engine adapts portable events to clients and ImGui, and Diligent borrows a native window.

nodes.label: ModuleManager lifecycle orchestration
nodes.description: One EngineModule lifecycle base supports owned, borrowed singleton, and DLL modules. Dependency validation rejects missing names/cycles; failure and shutdown reverse completed phases.

nodes.label: GraphicsModule Diligent integration
nodes.description: Owns Diligent device/context/swap-chain integration and graphics resource creation.

nodes.label: Independent networking transport layer
nodes.description: Portable endpoints and movable sockets expose Windows nonblocking UDP/TCP, readiness, resolution, and shared Winsock lifetime independently of windows. Startup registers no replication module or wire protocol; future replication/session/serialization policy belongs in the engine.

nodes.label: RenderSystem ECS renderer
nodes.description: RenderSystem connects ECS cameras, meshes, lights, shader registration/baking, paths, and passes, iterating active cameras and constructing FrameRenderData.

nodes.label: RenderingModule shared resources
nodes.description: RenderingModule supplies shared camera/animation constant buffers and final render targets.

nodes.label: C++/HLSL resource-name contract
nodes.description: Resource names such as NEMat_Diffuse1 and NEStatic_Camera connect shaders to C++ binding logic; CPU buffer layouts and shader reflection must remain aligned.

nodes.label: NuclearShader TOML descriptions
nodes.description: ShaderParser reads TOML-style NuclearShader descriptions accepting HLSL paths or embedded source.

nodes.label: ShaderPipeline variants and reflection
nodes.description: ShaderPipeline and its variant factory bake pipeline variants and reflection/bindings; mesh/material state selects variants and resources.

nodes.label: TextureCreateTask main-thread GPU creation
nodes.description: TextureCreateTask creates graphics resources on the main thread, removes queue membership, and cleans temporary image data. Task implementations may self-delete in OnEnd.

nodes.label: TextureImportTask worker decode
nodes.description: TextureImportTask decodes source data, can export NEMeta, and queues TextureCreateTask for main-thread resource creation.

nodes.label: ThreadingModule worker/main-thread queues
nodes.description: ThreadingModule manages a worker pool and a separate main-thread task list; the enabled engine loop executes up to one queued main-thread task per frame.
nodes.source_location: Assets and threading; Startup and client lifecycle

nodes.label: Shader/render-target coordinated change
nodes.description: Trace camera/mesh/material through pipeline/reflection/path/pass. Align shader names, descriptions, CPU/HLSL layouts, readiness, and resize behavior; validation covers only the backend actually exercised.

nodes.label: Asset readiness and ownership change
nodes.description: Trace import/load dispatch through task decoding and main-thread creation. Preserve ownership and Loaded/Created distinctions; update both persistence directions and inspect ignored fixtures.

nodes.label: Module ownership and reverse rollback
nodes.description: Use EngineModule dependency registration and paired lifecycle phases. DLL factories must match ABI, own and destroy their objects, and load before startup; validate relevant runtime behavior.
nodes.source_location: Add or change an engine module or audio backend

nodes.label: External engine module DLL ABI
nodes.description: Versioned GetNuclearEngineModulePlugin factories contribute named modules and dependencies. Startup scanning loads sorted Nuclear.Module.*.dll files; destroy callbacks precede unload and hot reload is unsupported.

nodes.label: Audio playback unvalidated by build
nodes.description: XAudio2/OpenAL plugins load by name without manifest discovery or hot swapping. A build does not verify audio-device initialization or playback.

nodes.label: Root CMake project
nodes.description: Adds engine, samples and dependency subdirectories; malformed CMAKE_MODULE_PATH noted in guides.

nodes.label: Animation source map
nodes.description: Maps Animator, AnimationClip, Bone, and asset animation headers for imported clips, bone transforms, and playback.

nodes.label: Graphics source map
nodes.description: Maps Diligent device creation, RenderSystem, shared frame data, cameras/buffers, shader parser/reflection/variants, materials, paths, passes, and postprocessing.

nodes.label: Physics audio editor source map
nodes.description: Maps PhysX simulation/components, audio module/plugin backends, editor entry/client/project, inspectors, panels, asset views, and logs.

nodes.label: Asset job serialization source map
nodes.description: Maps asset facade/library/state, import/load descriptions/adapters, tasks, threading queues, binary archives, metadata, and fallback resource implementations.

nodes.label: Plugin limitations
nodes.description: Module/audio DLLs load at startup by expected names and unload at shutdown; no hot reload, arbitrary manifest discovery, incompatible-ABI isolation, or audio-device validation follows from a build.

nodes.label: CMake Samples target
nodes.description: Names main.cpp and links Nuclear::Engine; filename casing mismatch documented.

nodes.label: Scoped source search
nodes.description: Narrow rg queries to owning subsystems and exclude bundled libraries/build noise; read the current implementation and callers after following source-map rows.

nodes.label: Cross-platform support unverified
nodes.description: Nuclear.Platform replaces SDL with neutral headers and a Windows x64 backend. Other backends remain unimplemented, and renderer/plugin/export/toolchain assumptions still require porting.

nodes.label: Portable CMake build unestablished
nodes.description: Root CMake syntax and dependency wiring are incomplete and sample source casing mismatches; a portable CMake build is unestablished.

nodes.label: CMake engine shared target
nodes.description: Sets C++20, globs native source and links DiligentCore, Assimp, OpenAL.

nodes.label: AI guide navigation
nodes.description: The index routes architecture, build, workflows, platform, networking transport/lifetime/readiness, source references, graph, and limitation questions to their relevant pages.

nodes.label: Incomplete CMake alternative
nodes.rationale: Root module-path syntax is malformed, dependency wiring sparse, and sample entry casing main.cpp differs from Main.cpp; not a verified alternative to MSBuild.

nodes.label: Windows x64 MSBuild workflow
nodes.rationale: Verified concrete workflow is Visual Studio/MSBuild; native host and installed managed runtime must be x64.

nodes.label: Performance and hardware query source map
nodes.description: Diagnostics.h/Win32Diagnostics.cpp own OS queries; GpuQuery.h, ProfilingModule.cpp, MemoryProfiler.h, and ProfilerWindow.cpp own renderer queries, frame capture, accounting and UI.
nodes.norm_label: performance and hardware query source map

nodes.label: Platform validation
nodes.description: Independent Windows smoke project checks synthetic events, physical key translation, Unicode, resize/close lifetime, native library lookup, invalid inputs, and repeated cleanup. It passed in Debug and Release on 2026-11-06. Physical devices, clipboard interaction, camera feel, and audio require sample checks.

nodes.label: Dependency integration validation
nodes.description: Read submodules, scripts, project settings, and library pragmas together. Preserve user edits, verify output names, scope integration changes, and distinguish setup failures from regressions.

nodes.label: AudioModule
nodes.rationale: Loads Nuclear.Audio.<name>.dll from executable directory or explicit plugin directory, validates ABI, initializes backend and unloads DLL at shutdown; initialization failure fails startup.

nodes.label: Audio backend startup configuration
nodes.rationale: mAudioBackendName selects XAudio2 or OpenAL; mAudioPluginDirectory overrides executable directory. Audio plugin projects must match engine configuration.

nodes.label: Default Samples audio blocker
nodes.rationale: The migration check initialized default Samples graphics and ImGui, but XAudio master-voice creation failed and prevented successful full startup. The focused engine fixture does not demonstrate default Samples startup or audio playback.

nodes.label: Dependency preparation
nodes.rationale: No complete bootstrap command exists. Preserve submodule changes, initialize recorded revisions without --remote, inspect interactive scripts, configure then build required configurations.

nodes.label: Diligent
nodes.rationale: Engine GraphicsTools links D3DBase, OpenGL-static, and Vk-static libraries in addition to other renderer libraries.

nodes.label: EngineModule
nodes.rationale: Built-in modules register directly; only asset manager uses a callback adapter. Asset-library paths and platform/window creation remain outside the manager.

nodes.label: GetNuclearEngineModulePlugin ABI
nodes.rationale: Version/size and factory table require compatible C++ ABI, architecture, runtime configuration; plugin destroy executes before FreeLibrary.

nodes.label: Engine-only MSBuild validation
nodes.rationale: A narrower native compile/link check uses Nuclear.Engine.vcxproj /m:1 /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=x64 in a normalized developer environment; SolutionDir is not required.

nodes.label: ModuleManager
nodes.rationale: Accepts owned modules, longer-lived borrowed singleton modules and external DLL modules before Start; resolves dependencies, rejects missing dependencies/cycles, rolls completed phases back in reverse order.

nodes.label: External module DLL loader
nodes.rationale: LoadPlugin loads one DLL; mModulePluginDirectory enables sorted Nuclear.Module.*.dll startup scanning. Running-module loading and hot reload are unsupported.

nodes.label: Module/audio validation scope
nodes.rationale: Module/audio DLLs require matching ABI, architecture, and runtime. Historical Debug builds do not validate external-module graphical startup or audio playback. During the platform migration default Samples graphics/ImGui initialized, but XAudio master-voice creation prevented full startup.
nodes.source_location: Module manager and audio plugins; Choosing validation

nodes.label: PhysX FreeImage FreeType msdf and libsndfile dependencies
nodes.norm_label: physx freeimage freetype msdf and libsndfile dependencies
nodes.rationale: Remaining SDKs must be supplied or built according to project include paths and link pragmas; SDL is no longer required.

nodes.label: BuildSupport build runner
nodes.rationale: Locates 64-bit MSBuild, normalizes duplicate Path/PATH in the process only, restores managed dependencies, and builds one worker to avoid observed task/parallel worker failures.

nodes.label: Standalone builds and outputs
nodes.rationale: Native and managed outputs go to Bin/DebugX64 or Bin/ReleaseX64; platform and audio DLLs sit beside engine and sample executables.

nodes.label: Validation evidence boundaries
nodes.rationale: Report exact configuration/command/sample/prerequisite; distinguish compiler, linker/dependency, missing-content and behavior failures. Sample labels do not prove clean-checkout runnability, and a full Release engine build is unverified.

nodes.label: Visual Studio 18 v145
nodes.rationale: First-party native projects target v145. Dependency names may still include vc143 or vc142; inspect outputs rather than changing toolsets incidentally.

nodes.label: XAudio2
nodes.rationale: Default backend; audio auto initialization needs a usable audio device.

nodes.label: CopyDependenciesBinaries.bat
nodes.rationale: Copies only a subset and always exits 0, so success does not prove all copies succeeded. Uses Release Assimp and FreeImage for both configurations.

nodes.label: Nuclear Engine.sln
nodes.rationale: Concrete Windows build entry point; native projects use Debug/Release x64, principally C++20, while Nuclear.Managed.Native uses C++17.

nodes.label: RunCmakeForDependencies.bat
nodes.rationale: Selects Visual Studio 18 2026 x64 for Assimp, Diligent, OpenAL; Diligent/OpenAL also receive CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5.

nodes.label: IPv6-only sockets and IPv4 broadcast
nodes.description: Binding port zero requests an ephemeral port retrievable via GetLocalEndpoint. IPv6 sockets are IPv6-only, so serving both families needs separate sockets. SetBroadcast applies only to IPv4 UDP.

nodes.label: Pending TCP connect and SO_ERROR completion
nodes.description: Connect can succeed immediately or return InProgress. After writable/error readiness call FinishConnect even on error readiness; it checks SO_ERROR and nonblockingly polls until completion. Readiness alone is not success; after failure close/reopen before retrying.
nodes.norm_label: pending tcp connect and so_error completion

nodes.label: Independent socket threads and external synchronization
nodes.description: Different sockets may run on different threads. Every operation on the same socket, including Close, moves, and destruction, requires external synchronization; concurrent cancellation is not provided.
nodes.norm_label: independent socket threads and external synchronization

nodes.label: IPv4/IPv6 endpoints and synchronous resolution
nodes.description: Endpoint stores address bytes in network order, port in host order, and optional numeric IPv6 scope. ParseEndpoint handles numeric addresses without DNS; ResolveHost synchronously resolves ASCII hostnames/numeric addresses and deduplicates results, off the frame thread.

nodes.label: Socket transport change workflow
nodes.description: Keep native runtime/socket types private, preserve nonblocking results, UDP boundaries, TCP partial transfers, and runtime ownership; enumerate compilation units and run Debug/Release NetworkTests. Higher-level replication/session policy belongs above the foundation.

nodes.label: Explicit portable networking operation results
nodes.description: NetworkResult carries a portable category, original native diagnostic where available, and valid successful byte count. Output endpoints/resolution lists remain unchanged on failure. DescribeError formats the result without mutable global last-error state.

nodes.label: Networking source map
nodes.description: Networking.h declares portable API; Win32Networking.cpp implements runtime/address/error services, Win32Socket.cpp implements sockets, and Tests/NetworkingSmoke.cpp exercises headless transport. The Networking guide defines ownership, protocol, and readiness contracts.

nodes.label: Networking validation and implementation limits
nodes.description: No full Release engine build, LAN/WAN interoperability, packet-loss recovery, replication, wire protocol compatibility, authentication, encryption, or other OS backend was validated or implemented by the loopback tests.

nodes.label: Platform socket transport foundation
nodes.description: Nuclear::Platform::Networking exposes C++20 endpoint/socket transport for future engine networking. Windows Winsock is the only implementation; public headers expose neither native socket handles nor OS headers.

nodes.label: Networking Debug/Release validation evidence
nodes.description: On 2026-11-06 headless Windows x64 networking tests passed in Debug and Release for IPv4/IPv6 UDP/TCP, and the full Debug engine/editor/sample solution built with the networking exports.

nodes.label: Nonblocking socket default
nodes.description: Open creates nonblocking sockets by default. WouldBlock, InProgress, TimedOut, and ConnectionClosed are distinct results; no implicit send-all loops, background receive threads, or unbounded waits are introduced.
nodes.source_location: UDP and game-loop use; TCP and readiness

nodes.label: Empty and truncated UDP datagrams
nodes.description: ReceiveFrom needs a nonempty buffer and writes sender only on success. Zero transferred bytes is a valid empty datagram. MessageTooLarge consumes an oversized datagram; discard possibly modified buffer contents. WouldBlock means no queued datagram.

nodes.label: TCP partial transfers and caller message framing
nodes.description: Send and Receive perform one operation and can transfer only part of a payload. Callers retain unsent bytes, accumulate input, and frame messages above the transport. Empty Send succeeds with zero bytes; empty receive buffers are rejected.
nodes.norm_label: tcp partial transfers and caller message framing

nodes.label: UDP datagram boundaries and delivery limits
nodes.description: SendTo sends one datagram and ReceiveFrom consumes one. UDP may lose, duplicate, or reorder packets and practical path packet limits vary; successful local send does not acknowledge delivery. The example packet-size and per-tick budget are caller policy, not platform constants.
nodes.norm_label: udp datagram boundaries and delivery limits

nodes.label: TCP listen and accept contract
nodes.description: Servers open TCP, bind, listen, and accept into an empty socket. Nonblocking listeners return WouldBlock when no connection is pending; accepted sockets inherit the wrapper blocking mode.

nodes.label: Socket options and pending-connect mode constraints
nodes.description: SetNoDelay controls TCP latency policy; SetBufferSizes requests positive native-adjustable buffer sizes. Worker threads can select blocking mode, but changing blocking mode during pending connect is rejected.
nodes.norm_label: socket options and pending-connect mode constraints

nodes.label: TCP send half-close and receive EOF
nodes.description: Shutdown(Send) half-closes a TCP stream so the peer sees EOF after queued bytes while replies can still be received. The socket remains owned until Close.
nodes.norm_label: tcp send half-close and receive eof

nodes.label: Lazy shared Winsock runtime independent of windows
nodes.description: Socket and resolver operations automatically hold shared internal runtime references. Winsock starts lazily; each socket closes before releasing its reference. No window, Platform::Initialize, event pump, or main-thread service is required, and networking survives window shutdown.
nodes.norm_label: lazy shared winsock runtime independent of windows
nodes.rationale: Socket/runtime ownership must work headlessly and remain independent of window initialization or shutdown.

nodes.label: Movable owned socket lifetime
nodes.description: Socket is noncopyable and movable, closes on destruction, and closes its previous destination during move assignment. Open requires an empty socket; Close precedes reopening or retrying a failed connection. Nuclear.Platform must remain loaded until sockets are destroyed.

nodes.label: Future engine replication and session policy
nodes.description: The foundation owns native transport, address translation, readiness, diagnostics, and basic options. Peer/session identity, connection policy, message formats/framing, serialization, replication, reliability, sequencing, budgets, encryption, and authentication remain higher-level policy and are not implemented here.
nodes.norm_label: future engine replication and session policy
nodes.rationale: Separating transport from gameplay/session/wire policy keeps Nuclear.Platform an independent OS foundation and leaves replication design in higher-level engine code.

nodes.label: Headless IPv4/IPv6 UDP/TCP tests
nodes.description: The separate NetworkTests project uses ephemeral loopback ports, offline localhost/numeric resolution, and bounded waits without initializing windows. It covers both IP families, UDP empty/truncated packets, readiness/refused connections, partial TCP/half-close/EOF, move/reopen ownership, invalid input, and concurrent independent runtime lifetimes.

nodes.label: Readiness polling and bounded timeouts
nodes.description: Wait takes 0..INT_MAX milliseconds; zero polls, TimedOut leaves readiness empty, and errors are monitored even when only read/write was requested. Readable TCP may be orderly EOF, distinguished by Receive returning ConnectionClosed.

nodes.label: Private Winsock backend and Windows SDK linking
nodes.description: Win32Networking.cpp owns runtime/address/resolution/error services; Win32Socket.cpp owns transport operations. Private Win32Networking.h contains Winsock types. Nuclear.Platform links SDK ws2_32.lib without a third-party networking SDK; future backends must preserve ownership/nonblocking/datagram/stream/error contracts.
nodes.norm_label: private winsock backend and windows sdk linking

nodes.label: Networking transport limits
nodes.description: Windows UDP/TCP transport and headless loopback tests exist. Replication, reliable UDP, sessions, message framing, encryption/authentication, and other OS backends are unimplemented; LAN/WAN behavior is unverified.
